Brief facts:
The petitioner is a mutt situated in Re. Sy. No.9/2, Hulgundi Village, Chitradurga measuring 6 acres 22 guntas, a portion of which abuts the main road connecting to the Chitradurga city limits.

In June 2022, as part of the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (Amrut) Scheme, the 3rd respondent approached the petitioner-Mutt NC: 2025:KHC:39647 HC-KAR seeking a portion of the land measuring 60 meters in length and 5 meters in breadth, i.e., about 30 guntas for the purpose of road widening.

entities.text: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (Amrut) Scheme
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Since the project of road widening was in public interest, the petitioner voluntarily permitted the respondents to utilize the said portion of land upon assurance that suitable compensation would be awarded under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ('Land Acquisition Act, 2013' for short).
3.

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned AGA for the respondents.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner handed over 30 guntas of land abutting the main road in Sy. No.9/2 and the respondents have since completed the project of road widening in April 2023.

However, despite repeated representations, the respondents have failed to determine and dispose the representations dated 10.06.2024 (Annexures-A and B) addressed to respondent Nos.2 and 3 remain unattended.
NC: 2025:KHC:39647 HC-KAR 5.
Learned AGA for the respondents submits that the said representations will be considered in accordance with law, if reasonable time is granted.
6. The submission of the learned AGA is placed on record.

7. Having regard to the fact that the petitioner's representations are of June 2024, and that the land has already been taken for public use, it is appropriate that the same be considered expeditiously.

Accordingly, the respondents are directed to consider the petitioner's representations dated 10.06.2024 (Annexures-A and B) and to take appropriate action within an outer limit of three months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order, in accordance with law.
With the said observations, the writ petition stands disposed of.
